CoSchedule vs VEXI: Which Is Better for Realtors in 2026?
CoSchedule and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
Compare CoSchedule vs VEXI side-by-side. See pricing, features, and why 1,000+ realtors choose VEXI for done-for-you social media.
CoSchedule is social media management software built on a marketing calendar [1][2]. VEXI makes and posts your social content. They overlap on scheduling, and in many ways they fit together.

CoSchedule describes itself as social media management software built on a calendar: marketers plan campaigns, publish to 11 networks, reply from one Social Inbox and measure results in the same tool, alone or with a team [2]. Its AI Social Assistant and AI Campaign Assistant draft posts and whole campaigns, images included, for you to review [1][2].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
The two overlap on scheduling and do different main jobs. Here is what each one does.
CoSchedule’s AI writes social messages, drafts whole campaigns onto your calendar with images included, and generates images [1][2]. Its media editing lets you edit images before publishing [2].
VEXI does it all for you.
CoSchedule publishes Instagram Reels and Stories, Facebook Reels, TikTok videos and YouTube Shorts from the same calendar [2].
VEXI edits your videos for you.
CoSchedule is built for marketers and marketing teams, from the one-person marketing department on Starter to teams coordinating social and content across brands on Suite [2].

CoSchedule’s Starter plan is $29 a month and Professional $49 a month, billed annually, or $39 and $59 billed monthly; Suite is custom, from $69 a month [2]. Starter includes 3 social profiles and Professional 5, with each extra profile $5 a month [2].

Does CoSchedule create content for you?

It drafts it. CoSchedule’s AI Social Assistant writes social messages, its AI Campaign Assistant drafts a whole campaign onto your calendar with images included, and it can generate images [1][2]. CoSchedule then schedules and publishes your posts [2].
Yes. CoSchedule publishes Instagram Reels and Stories, Facebook Reels, TikTok videos and YouTube Shorts [2].
Which platforms does CoSchedule publish to?
Every paid CoSchedule plan publishes to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Google Business Profile, YouTube and X [2].

CoSchedule’s Starter plan is $29 a month and Professional $49 a month billed annually, or $39 and $59 billed monthly; Suite is custom, from $69 a month [2]. Starter and Professional each come with a 14-day free trial, and there is a free plan that schedules up to 15 posts at a time on one profile [2].
